requirements.description: Annual financial-statement inputs for the frozen baseline and Jones construction: accruals, revenue, gross PP&E, cash/current assets/current liabilities, debt, depreciation, assets, net income before extraordinary items, common equity and market capitalization. The sample begins with Worldscope data for 1988–2000; final baseline rows are 1990–1999.

required_coverage.population: Listed firms from 9 East Asian and 13 Western European sample countries, before industry/negative-item/ownership screens.
required_coverage.detail: Source sample table starts with 77,953 firm-years from 1988–2000. Historical records support changes, lagged assets, and three consecutive fiscal years.

routes.mapping_notes: Catalog labels map ITEM1001 to net sales/revenues; ITEM1551 to net income before extra items/preferred dividends; ITEM2001 to cash and short-term investments; ITEM2301 to gross PP&E; ITEM2999 to total assets; ITEM3051/ITEM3251 to short-/long-term debt; ITEM3101 to current liabilities; ITEM3351 to total liabilities; ITEM3501 to common equity; ITEM7210/ITEM7220 to U.S.-dollar market capitalization/common equity. code/year_/freq/ITEM5350 are company/fiscal-period identifiers. Historical vintage and linkage are unverified.

variable_coverage.construction: Indirect balance-sheet total accruals for a separate cross-sectional Jones fit by two-digit SIC and year. Candidate inputs include Worldscope current assets, cash/short-term investments, current liabilities, short-term debt, tax payable, and depreciation fields. The paper does not print the exact total-accrual formula or scaling; do not substitute a conventional formula.
Change in Worldscope net sales/revenues (ITEM1001) from t−1 to t, divided by lagged total assets (ITEM2999 at t−1); exact item-level period construction is not stated.
Worldscope gross PP&E (ITEM2301) at t divided by total assets (ITEM2999) at t−1.
abs(DACC) from the supporting SIC-year cross-sectional Jones fit. Exact total-accrual formula and residual arithmetic are not reported.
Diverge=1−cash-flow rights/voting rights of the largest ultimate owner; set to 0 for firms with no ultimate owner. Requires undocumented ownership-to-Worldscope linkage.
Diverge multiplied by common-law indicator (1 common law, 0 civil law).
Diverge multiplied by the country ICR efficiency score averaged over 1980–1983.
Diverge multiplied by the 1995 country tax-compliance score.
Country common-law indicator, coded 1 for common law and 0 for civil law.
Country ICR judicial-efficiency rating averaged over 1980–1983, scale 0–10.
Country tax-compliance score from 1995, scale 0–6.
Cash-flow rights of the largest controlling ultimate owner.
Controlling-owner cash-flow rights multiplied by the common-law indicator.
Controlling-owner cash-flow rights multiplied by ICR efficiency averaged over 1980–1983.
Controlling-owner cash-flow rights multiplied by the 1995 tax-compliance score.
Natural logarithm of country per-capita GNP in constant 1994 U.S. dollars; observation year/series is unspecified.
Indicator for two-digit SIC codes 40–49 or 60–63.
Natural logarithm of lagged book total assets in billions of U.S. dollars.
Market value of common equity divided by book equity. Worldscope ITEM7210 and ITEM7220 are candidate U.S.-dollar market capitalization/common-equity fields; verify historical-vintage mapping.

Conflicting source definitions: page 14 says short- plus long-term debt/current assets; Table 3 says total liabilities/total assets at end of prior year. Raw fields are present but the formula cannot be uniquely selected.
Income before extraordinary items (ITEM1551) divided by lagged total assets (ITEM2999 at t−1), following Table 3.
Absolute value of Table 3 ROA: abs(ITEM1551_t/ITEM2999_t−1).
Absolute change in income before extraordinary items scaled by lagged total assets: |ITEM1551_t−ITEM1551_t−1|/ITEM2999_t−1, following Table 3.

1990–1999 fiscal years, Worldscope industrial firms in 22 countries; remove financial institutions and negative/missing data, require three consecutive same-fiscal-year-end years, screen extreme Jones drivers and SIC-year groups under eight, then merge ownership rows. implementation_issues.description: The paper reports a pooled Table 6 regression and White robust covariance but does not identify the coefficient estimator. Do not infer OLS from the linear equation or covariance choice.

The supporting Jones fit uses indirect balance-sheet accruals and Δrevenue/gross PP&E scaled by lagged assets, but the exact total-accrual formula/scaling and DACC residual arithmetic are not printed; revenue change endpoints are also not explicit.

Original source conflict: page 14 defines Leverage as short- plus long-term debt over total assets; Table 3 defines total liabilities over total assets at the end of the previous year. Preserve both definitions; neither is silently chosen.
The selected Table 6 column is labelled pooled, but fixed-effect status is not reported and the source does not explicitly say there are none.

The required design uses historical Worldscope records for 1988–2000; the local Worldscope source is current vintage. Restatement, identifier and industry-classification vintage differences are not quantified.

The Jones fit is estimated by two-digit SIC-year before the ownership merge; 34,250 is an aggregate post-screen count, not a per-fit N.
